description: IGN earthquake catalogue (Spain and adjacent areas) is a hazard data portal run by Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN), Spain. A searchable catalogue of earthquakes from the year 1370 to the present for Spain, its adjacent seas and the Canary Islands, filterable by zone, date range, intensity, magnitude and depth, with optional seismic phase readings; earthquakes before 1370 are in a separate PDF. Coverage: Spain and the Canary Islands, 1370 to present. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page; a DOI (10.7419/162.03.2022) is given for citation. Caveats: download formats and a web-service address are not stated on the page; older events rely on historical intensity estimates. It can support seismic hazard inputs for Iberian infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
